title: Imputed Righteousness
definition: Imputed Righteousness is the crediting of Christ's righteousness to believers so they stand accepted before God.
summary: Imputed Righteousness is the crediting of Christ's righteousness to believers by faith.
christFocus: Jesus Christ obeyed perfectly and becomes the righteousness of those who trust in Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Imputed righteousness explains why the believer is accepted before God. Salvation is not only the removal of sin but the granting of a righteous standing in Christ. The obedience of Jesus is counted to those who trust Him, so their confidence rests in His record rather than their spiritual performance.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many try to stand before God with a mixed record of effort, regret, and comparison. Imputation destroys boasting and despair by pointing to the righteousness of Another. It gives the believer courage to approach God with confidence and humility.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Stop measuring your acceptance by your strongest or weakest day. Thank Christ for a righteousness you did not produce. Pursue obedience as a grateful child, not as a defendant trying to build a case.
